fact: The Government Cloud Strategy 2023-2027 says the government deployed a data centre managed by state operator Gamtel, described as Tier 2 in one place and Tier 3 in another, intended to host critical government platforms but with low utilisation, and Gamtel provides private cloud services.
title: Government Cloud Strategy 2023 - 2027 The Gambia
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy (The Gambia)
